# `tokens/` (CI-derived, flat)

This directory does NOT use the `src/`+`dist/` split that other derived domains do. `tokens.json` and
`tokens.css` are written in place, at the top level, by `scripts/tokens/derive-tokens.js`. The flat
layout is historical rather than principled; see the Phase B note below.

**Everything in the table below except `figma-bindings-raw.json` is generated. Do not hand-edit it.**

## Contents

| File | Origin | Editable? |
|---|---|---|
| `tokens.json` | 🤖 CI-generated by `scripts/tokens/derive-tokens.js` (self-discloses via `$metadata.generatedBy`, `$metadata._frozen: false`) | NO, edits reverted on the next derive |
| `tokens.css` | 🤖 CI-generated by the same script via `scripts/tokens/emit-css.js` (carries an `AUTO-GENERATED` header) | NO, same |
| `token-reference.md` | 🤖 CI-generated by `scripts/render-token-reference.js` from `tokens.json` (carries an `AUTO-GENERATED` HTML comment banner) | NO, same |
| `src/derived/*.tokens.json` | 🤖 CI-generated intermediates (primitives, semantics, numerics) | NO, same |
| `src/figma-bindings-raw.json` | ✋ Human-maintained: bindings harvested from Figma | YES |
| `dist/tokens.dtcg.json` | 🤖 CI-generated portable DTCG export by `scripts/render/derive-dtcg.js` | NO, same |

## How a token value is produced

```
foundations/src/color-primitives.md   (OKLCH shade formula + palette 500 bases)
foundations/src/tokens.md             (semantic token mappings)
tokens/src/figma-bindings-raw.json    (harvested Figma bindings)
        -> npm run derive:tokens  (scripts/tokens/derive-tokens.js)
        -> tokens/src/derived/*.tokens.json
        -> tokens/tokens.json, tokens/tokens.css
        -> token-reference.md (separate script), dist/tokens.dtcg.json
```

CI runs `derive:tokens` in `.github/workflows/foundations-derive.yml`, so a foundations edit refreshes
the tokens in the same PR.

## To change a token

Edit the **foundations source**, not the output:

- a palette base or the shade formula: `foundations/src/color-primitives.md`
- a semantic mapping (which primitive a role points at): `foundations/src/tokens.md`

Then run `npm run derive:tokens` and commit the regenerated files alongside your source edit. Editing
`tokens.json` or `tokens.css` directly does not survive: the next derive overwrites it.

## Shade values are computed, not copied from Figma

Each palette has a named 500 base, and every other shade is derived from it by the shared OKLCH formula
in `color-primitives.md`. Figma stores hand-picked hex. **The two can legitimately differ**, and
`color-primitives.md` says which to trust for what:

> Figma stores colors as hex values. Engineering uses OKLCH with the formula above. There can be minor
> visual differences between platforms, always defer to the Figma file for design decisions and
> engineering code for production output.

Two consequences worth knowing before treating a difference as a bug:

- Shades currently marked 🟡 Proposed in `color-primitives.md` (the whole 25 tier, among others) ship
  the newly computed value while Figma may still hold the previous hand-picked one.
- Most color tokens are defined up to three times here, under `:root`/`[data-theme="actian"]`,
  `[data-theme="studio"]`, and `[data-theme="explorer"]`. A consumer that reads only the first
  definition gets the actian value regardless of the theme it meant.

Both were mistaken for token drift once already; see issue #489.

## History

`tokens.json` and `tokens.css` were genuinely human-frozen for a period after the plugin's
`/sync-design-system` generator was decommissioned in plugin v1.79.0 (2026-05-10). Knowledge has since
grown its own generator (`scripts/tokens/derive-tokens.js`), and this README plus the `tokens.css`
header both went stale describing the frozen state. Corrected 2026-07-24.

## Phase B note

Phase B of the knowledge-repo restructure (see `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-10-knowledge-repo-restructure-design.md`
in the plugin repo, gitignored) chose to keep `tokens/` flat while the successor generator was pending.
The generator has landed, so adopting the standard `src/`+`dist/` split is now a live option rather than
a blocked one. Re-raise when someone is willing to move the consumer-facing paths.
